caption: Class.create(), .prototype, initialize, and type — every production class has all four.
new IncidentUtils() triggers initialize immediately.

steps.label: Class.create()
steps.sub: returns a constructor function — called later as new ClassName()

steps.label: .prototype = { }
steps.sub: lists every method in one object, classical-OOP style

steps.label: initialize
steps.sub: the constructor — runs the instant new ClassName() executes

steps.label: type: 'ClassName'
steps.sub: required; must match the class name exactly, used by platform reflection
